name: Loktantra Senani Samman Pension Scheme for Widowed Wife or Widower Husband of Democracy Fighters of the State Imprisoned under MISA/DIR during Emergency Period (from 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977)
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a widow or widower of a recognized democracy fighter. 1. The applicant’s deceased spouse must have been imprisoned under MISA/DIR during the Emergency period from 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977.
